description: Designation of Businesses as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Prime Melwa Port City (Pvt) Limited and Home Lands Port City (Pvt) Limited have planned to construct an ultra-luxury residential tower and an eco-friendly luxury residential twin tower in the Colombo Port City, investing US$ 127.6 million and US$ 150.0 million respectively. The implementation of these projects will create approximately 1,170 new job opportunities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to designate Prime Melwa Port City (Pvt) Limited and Home Lands Port City (Pvt) Limited as Primary Businesses of Strategic Importance under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, and to grant them exemptions or incentives proposed in the Act, was approved by the Cabinet.
